policy.title: Pre-review, links and pace
policy.lead: For each surface, choose when a post goes to review before it becomes visible: always (pre-review), beyond a number of links, or beyond a number of writes by the same member within a time window, across all surfaces. Every change needs a reason, is recorded in the decision log and applies to later writes.
policy.exceptions: Without a setting, shop offers and terms, job offers, service reviews and their replies, page events and the posts in their galleries wait for review. DIASPORALE’s own content (mutual aid, mentoring, arrival kit, jobs) is published without automatic checks.
policy.withoutDefaults: No setting: the engine defaults apply (pre-review: {{review}}; at most {{links}} links; {{writes}} writes per {{seconds}} s).
policy.withoutHeld: No setting: every item on this surface waits for review before it becomes visible.
policy.withoutUnchecked: No setting: items on this surface are published without automatic checks.
policy.maxLinksHint: Beyond this number of links, the write goes to review.

policy.maxWritesHint: Beyond this, the member’s next write goes to review.
policy.maxWritesInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
policy.windowHint: Period over which the member’s writes are counted.
policy.windowInvalid: Enter a whole number of seconds from {{min}} to {{max}}.
policy.noneConfigured: No surface has a setting yet: the rules above apply.
